decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed single-storey side and rear extension, because of its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of 52 Midsummer Avenue, would be compatible with the character and appearance of the property and the streetscene, and would not harm the living conditions of the adjoining occupiers. The development is therefore in accordance with Unitary Development Plan policies (December 2003) ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4 and the Council's Residential Guidelines (July 2002).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is used.

Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing single-storey side extension at the adjoining semi-detached property number 54 Midsummer Avenue.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northeast and southwest walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the test results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.

Where measures are required, they shall be installed before the development is occupied or such other time as may be required by the Local Planning Authority
description: Erection of single storey side and rear extension to dwellinghouse.
